title: Bosun Universal Meta-Envelope Contract v1
description: Universal Meta-Envelope contract ($pkm namespace) defining the required identity, canonical realm, timestamps, and typed relations. `$pkm.relations` accepts the canonical verb map or the harbormaster locker-note edge array.

pkmEnvelope.description: Universal Meta-Envelope ($pkm namespace) identifying the entity, canonical realm, timestamps, and typed relations.

id.description: UUIDv7 URN uniquely identifying this entity.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC date-time string (Postel coercion: permissive ingestion of date strings missing seconds).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC date-time string (Postel coercion: permissive ingestion of date strings missing seconds).

schema.description: Harbormaster locker-note schema prefix ($<realm>:<type>/v1). Optional. Used with a top-level note id when $pkm.id is omitted.

urn.description: Optional explicit entity URN. Harbormaster graph_query prefers this over reconstructing urn:<realm>:<type>:<id>.

relations.description: Either a typed verb map (canonical relations.schema.json) or an array of {target,type} edges (harbormaster locker notes / older yeoman interaction form).

oneOf.description: Map of typed predicate verbs to URN strings or URN arrays.
Edge list used by harbormaster locker notes.
